beats.text: Most things shrink when frozen. Water grows.
In liquid water, molecules jostle and bonds keep breaking.
Cool it and each molecule locks onto four neighbours.
A hexagonal lattice with empty space inside.
That's nine percent more room. One litre becomes one point oh nine.
So lakes freeze from the top and fish live below.
Open rings, less density. Ice floats.
Follow for more, and see how everything works.
